"The depiction of Nataraja is often shown in paintings and sculptures. In a Nataraja sculpture, he typically stands in a dancing pose, with his right leg raised and left leg resting on the demon Apasmara, who represents ignorance. Nataraja has four arms, with the upper right hand holding a drum (symbolizing creation) and the lower right hand in the abhaya mudra (gesture of fearlessness). The upper left hand holds fire (symbolizing destruction) and the lower left hand points to his raised left foot (symbolizing refuge or salvation).
